excluded.name: MINERAL LAKE
excluded.why: rec.gov: 'We apologize, this campground is currently closed'; the Forest Service's Mineral Lake Recreation Area page now lists only a boat launch and picnic area, no campground. Treated like Yellowbottom (OR): no stated plan to reopen
